{{Quote|Xizor Transport. A Black Sun front-company with impressive legitimate profits. Owned by Prince Xizor of House Sizhran.|[[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]]|<ref name="Prey">''[[Evasive Action: Prey]]''</ref>}}
'''Xizor Transport Systems (XTS)''', also known as '''Xizor Transport Company''', was a major shipping conglomerate owned by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] with its [[Xizor Transport Company headquarters|corporate headquarters]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. 
==History==
The immense megacorporation maintained a fleet of huge [[container transport]]s, [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk]] and [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] hauling cargo across [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] or swiftly delivering valuable shipments for high-paying customers.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

XTS manufactured a number of [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] design for large-scale transport and trading operations, including [[container transport]]s, the [[XQ4 Platform]], and a wide variety of [[Xizor cargo container|modular cargo containers]]. One of their most commonly used ships was the [[AEG-77 Vigo]].

The profits from XTS helped finance [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operations and provided a front for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] laundering. It also allowed Xizor to gain contacts within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], by supplying bases and [[garrison/Legends|garrisons]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and by winning a number of lucrative Imperial contracts for defense projects such as the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="sb" /><ref name="soten">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

Xizor's [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] also used XTS for Black Sun's operations, like moving personnel and contraband to various locations of [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="sb" />

It was said that the credits made from the XTS alone was enough to make Xizor a wealthy being, however, added to the profits of Black Sun Xizor became one of the wealthiest beings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="sb" /> surpassed only by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

Some of the XTS starships were destroyed [[Battle over Coruscant|above]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when Darth Vader destroyed Xizor's [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'', after Xizor attempted to defy the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].

[[Asador Leen]] was a known crew chief.<ref name="1MToRS">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|regional/13516_2.html|100 Metric Tons of Ryll Seized}}</ref>
